job.title: Senior Core Product Marketing Manager
job.description:
We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team. This role owns the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for one or more products within the Articulate platform, including the GTM plan against revenue goals and the commercial model behind it.
You will shape messaging, pricing and packaging, use funnel data and AI systems to sharpen the plan, and build the launch foundations for execution. You will partner with product, marketing, sales, customer success, growth, ops, and ecosystem and reseller partners to shape the roadmap and carry recommendations to senior leaders. We are looking for someone who writes the playbook, builds the systems the team runs on, and is accountable for the plan that delivers a revenue goal.

- Revenue and GTM plan. Own the GTM plan against the revenue goal for your product(s). Work with Sales and Ops on targets, track progress against them, and decide what to scale, fix, pause or stop as results come in.

- 

Commercial model. Shape the pricing, packaging, and monetization approach for your product(s). Make recommendations and carry them through to a decision with cross-functional partners.

- 

Shared context and systems. Build and maintain the positioning, messaging, and competitive context, plus the skills and workflows, that the PMM team and its AI agents run on.

- 

Funnel data and insights. Own the funnel for your product(s), from first touch through conversion and expansion. Help shape the dashboards and metrics the team relies on, using them to turn insights into GTM strategy and execution.

- 

Field readiness. Act as the voice of product, owning field messaging, FAQs, web content, and live enablement for Sales, Customer Success, and reseller partners.

- 

Build positioning, value propositions, and differentiated messaging for the full buying committee, from practitioners and business creators to administrators and IT stakeholders, and hold a high quality bar on what the team ships

- 

Develop deep insight into customers, segments, and target accounts, and use research, usage data, and buying signals to guide GTM plans and the roadmap

- 

Build the launch and campaign foundations (plans, templates, assets, standards) that Growth, Content, and Sales execute from

- 

Work with Product and Engineering on the roadmap, and make the case for what to build next and how it should be priced and packaged

- 

Work with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Marketing leadership to reach decisions on commercial strategy that cross teams

- 

Adapt GTM across ecosystem, integration, and reseller partners as revenue channels, including positioning, co-marketing, enablement, and shared account plans

- 

Build with AI every day - create workflows and agents for your own work, and add to the team's shared context, skills, and agents so everyone's output improves

- 

Decide what to do yourself, what to delegate, and what to automate

- 

Create internal and field assets, track competitors and market trends, and support events

- 

8+ years of product marketing experience, B2B SaaS preferred

- 

A track record of owning a GTM plan against a revenue goal or other commercial outcome, and making calls on what to scale, fix, or stop based on data

- 

Experience shaping pricing, packaging, and monetization, ideally including usage-based or credit-based models

- 

Hands-on AI proficiency to speed up your work and apply your own judgment to the output

- 

A high-quality bar for excellent storytelling with the ability to turn complex or technical ideas into a clear narrative that stands out

- 

Experience owning a funnel, plus strong comfort with funnel metrics and dashboards used to shape messaging, strategy, and decisions

- 

Experience building a launch or GTM framework from a blank page that others then adopted

- 

Ability to operate in ambiguity, flex across shifting priorities, and execute in adjacent areas like Growth, Ops and even Sales

- 

Experience with ecosystem, integration, or reseller partnerships, ideally as a revenue channel

- 

Proven ability to make strategic recommendations to senior leaders and reach a decision

- 

Strong cross-functional collaboration across product, sales, customer success, growth, operations, legal, and partners

- 

Experience raising the bar for peers through templates, standards, or coaching

- 

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience, MBA preferred

- 

Nice to have: experience with e-learning creation or delivery tools, including Articulate 360

 About us

Articulate Global, LLC, is the leading SaaS provider of creator platforms for online workplace training. Founded by Adam Schwartz in 2002, Articulate provides creator tools and services that make it simple for enterprises and SMBs to develop, deliver, and analyze online workplace training that’s engaging and effective.  Increasingly, organizations must reskill employees for ever-changing remote and hybrid work environments, create learning cultures that attract and retain employees in a tight labor market, and use training to build more equitable, empowering, and engaging workplaces. Articulate helps organizations address these critical business needs with its creator platform for workplace training. Articulate 360—a suite of creator tools for online courses—was named the 7th most-loved product in the world by TrustRadius in 2021. And Rise—an all-in-one online training system that makes online training easy to create, enjoyable to take, and simple to manage—is the first creator platform for SMBs and departments within the enterprise. Articulate has more than 118,000 customers in 170 countries and counts all 100 of the Fortune 100 companies as customers.

Named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces 2022 and a leader in building a human-centered organization, Articulate is guided by a commitment to provide the best value to customers, do right by employees, and create an equitable, empowering workplace for all. As a human-centered organization, we honor people’s humanity knowing that each person’s unique history, vulnerabilities, and social location inform how we show up with one another. We embrace our connectedness, aware that what we do and say impacts others. We give each other grace because we are all works in progress, learning and evolving every day. And we take responsibility for ourselves and are serious about our accountability to each other.  In all we do, we strive to create an equitable, sustainable, and empowering workplace while we drive results for the business and make a positive impact in the world. Read more about our values here. 

Articulate Global, LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All employment decisions at Articulate are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications directly related to the job, without regard to any protected characteristic or class, including, but not limited to, race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. Qualified candidates with criminal histories will be considered for this role in a manner consistent with applicable law. Articulate is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. job.title: Senior SEO & GEO Specialist
job.description:
Headquarters: New York
    
URL: https://manaferra.com/

## Position overview

Manaferra is seeking a Senior SEO & GEO Specialist. The successful candidate will be responsible for the strategy and performance of university accounts, including auditing, defining the strategic direction, overseeing delivery, and reporting results to clients.

This is a strategy and ownership position. The Senior SEO & GEO Specialist serves as the strategic lead on each account and the primary authority on what is being done and why.

## Key responsibilities

- 

Audit and strategy development. Conduct comprehensive SEO and AI-visibility audits for new and existing accounts, and translate findings into prioritized strategies spanning technical SEO, on-page and program-page optimization, content, link building, and visibility within large language models.

- 

Execution oversight. Review deliverables and ensure the strategy is implemented as designed and on schedule. The role carries accountability for account results, not only for the strategic plan.

- 

Performance management. Monitor performance across organic search and AI platforms, identify trends and gaps, and adjust the strategy proactively.

- 

Client presentation. Participate in biweekly or monthly client calls together with the account manager; present work completed, results achieved, and the direction for the following period; and respond to client questions with authority.

- 

GEO practice development. Contribute to the evolution of Manaferra's methodology for tracking, influencing, and reporting on visibility in AI search.

## Qualifications

Required

- 

A minimum of 3 years of SEO experience in an agency environment, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple accounts and competing priorities.

- 

Hands-on experience in GEO / AI search, including work aimed at securing citations and recommendations in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, or comparable platforms, and a clear understanding of how this differs from traditional SEO.

- 

Strong strategic and analytical judgment, with the ability to assess a website, its competitive landscape, and available data, and to define and defend priorities.

- 

Excellent written and spoken English, with confidence presenting strategy and results to US-based university marketing teams.

- 

Proven ability to direct the work of colleagues outside a direct reporting line through clear briefs, structured review, and precise feedback.

- 

Availability for client calls held during US business hours

- 

Proficiency with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and GA4

- 

Familiarity with AI visibility tracking tools such as LLMPulse, Profound, Peec AI, or similar

- 

Experience with Looker Studio or comparable reporting and dashboard tools

- 

Basic automation skills (Google Sheets, Python, or similar)

## What we offer

- 

Fully remote, part-time employment with flexible working hours

- 

Ownership of a portfolio of accounts and meaningful influence over how the agency operates

- 

A dedicated specialist team executing your strategy, allowing you to focus on direction and results

- 

Direct involvement in one of the fastest-developing areas of search: AI visibility for higher education

## Application process

Please submit the following:

- 

Your CV

- 

One or two sample SEO or GEO audits and strategies you have produced (anonymized versions are acceptable)

- 

A portfolio or summary of accounts you have worked on and the results achieved (anonymized versions are acceptable)

Applications should be sent to careers@manaferra.com

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/manaferra-senior-seo-geo-specialist

job.title: Field Marketing Manager
job.description:
The Field Marketing Manager owns the field-sourced and field-influenced pipeline contribution for a combination of products, turning webinars, third-party partnerships, conferences, and customer events into qualified meetings and pipeline for Workforce Compliance.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Demand Generation, Workforce Compliance Marketing. The Field Marketing Manager works hand in hand with SDRs and AEs so every program ends in sales follow-up, not just attendance. The role runs the planned calendar (webinars, events, newsletter placements) and the signal-triggered plays that sit on top of it (post-event retargeting, webinar re-engagement, account-based outreach).

This role carries a named pipeline target for Workforce Compliance solutions, set with Sales and RevOps at the start of each quarter.

Pipeline planning and reporting

  • Build a quarterly field plan for Workforce Compliance solutions that maps programs to the pipeline target, MQL quota, and Sales priorities, and review it with the Director and Sales leaders each quarter.
  • Report weekly on MQLs, hot leads, meetings, hot-meeting conversion, and pipeline created by program.
  • Recommend where to add, cut, or reshape programs based on pipeline per dollar and per program, and act on the decision.

Webinars and third-party partnerships

  • Plan and run Mitratech-hosted webinars and AMAs, partnering with Product Marketing on topics, content, and speakers.
  • Manage third-party partners such as HR Morning, I Hate It Here, HR Brew, and HCI: placements, scheduling, co-hosted webinars, vendor budget, and a pipeline benchmark per partner.
  • Segment registrants into net-new and recycled, and tailor follow-up for each.

Events and in-person programs

  • Deliver conferences, regional events, executive roundtables, and prospect dinners, owning the pipeline plan from pre-event outreach through post-event follow-up.
  • Get target lists to SDRs early to pre-book meetings, and run post-event retargeting from badge scans and registrations.
  • Work with Customer Marketing to seat customer advocates at events and webinars, and with Partner Marketing on partner events and referrals.
  • Work with the Events team on booth, logistics, and vendor execution so that this role stays focused on pipeline outcomes.

Sales and SDR follow-up

  • Own what happens to every lead after a program: routing, SDR and AE talk tracks, re-engagement sprints, and follow-up timing.
  • Track conversion from MQL to meeting to opportunity by program, and diagnose where it breaks.
  • Meet regularly with SDR leadership and AEs to learn what prospects are saying and adjust messaging and targeting.
  • Route play-triggered leads directly to Sales with context, and measure each play against the pipeline it creates.

Cross-Sell and Signal-triggered plays

  • Identify and run plays that fire on a signal rather than the calendar, such as multi-registrant accounts, webinar attendance, badge scans, and intent data from tools like 6sense, ZoomInfo, and Qualified.
  • Build evergreen cross-sell programs between Workforce Compliance products.

Measurement, budget, and operations

  • Own campaign setup, naming, and source tagging in HubSpot and Salesforce, and reconcile attribution with RevOps.
  • Build repeatable playbooks and templates, and use AI to speed up list building, personalization, follow-up, and reporting.

Requirements & Skills

  • 5+ years in B2B field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation, with a record of contributing to a pipeline number.
  • Hands-on experience running in-person and virtual events and webinars as an individual contributor.
  • Experience working directly with SDRs and AEs, and a clear understanding of how Sales motions turn leads into meetings and opportunities.
  • Proven ability to report pipeline sourced, pipeline influenced, and conversion rates, using Salesforce and HubSpot (campaigns, attribution, reports) and a webinar platform such as Goldcast.
  • Strong project management and follow-through across multiple programs at once.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Content, Paid Media, Digital, ABM, Customer Marketing, and RevOps.
  • Day-to-day use of AI tools to speed up research, personalization, follow-up, and reporting.

We will disclose intended pay ranges in our job ads for US-based opportunities – This role can be performed 100% remote anywhere in the US. Anticipated Pay Range: $90,000 Annually USD

Total compensation includes US employee benefits and annual bonus eligibility.

  • Health, Dental & Vision Insurance *
  • 401 (k) + Employer Match *
  • Open PTO + 11 Paid Holidays + 4 Annual Paid Global Wellness Days Off
  • STD, LTD & Group Life Insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Pet Insurance
  • FSA & HSA Options
  • Employee Assistance Program

job.title: Influencer Marketing Manager
job.description:
About the role

MyFitnessPal is investing in creators as a scalable growth channel. As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will lead the day-to-day execution of our influencer program while owning how we measure its success and demonstrate its return on investment. You will manage a team of influencer specialists and work directly with talent, agents, and internal partners.

What you'll do

Day-to-day execution

  • Oversee creator communications and provide hands-on support throughout the partnership lifecycle, from outreach and onboarding to briefing, content delivery, payment and performance analysis
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with creators, talent managers, and agencies to drive loyalty, preferred rates, and repeat partnerships
  • Evaluate incoming and proposed influencer deals, determining which are worth pursuing based on audience fit, performance potential, and cost
  • Directly manage relationships with celebrity and macro influencers, including negotiation oversight and content planning
  • Review creator content to ensure it meets brand standards, messaging requirements, and campaign objectives
  • Track influencer performance against established KPIs and report results to stakeholders on a regular cadence

Program management

  • Manage influencer budgets and allocate spend across creators, tiers, and platforms to maximize return
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (e.g., Brand, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Legal, Finance) to support ongoing marketing campaigns and integrate creator activity into broader plans
  • Lead, coach, and develop influencer specialists who negotiate creator contracts, setting priorities, deal guidelines, and quality standards
  • Improve existing automations and build new automated processes (e.g., outreach, tracking, reporting, payments) to increase team efficiency and scalability

Strategy and measurement

  • Develop influencer strategies and programs aligned with overall brand and business objectives
  • Research industry trends, emerging platforms, and competitor activity, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
  • Determine how we define and measure program success, including the KPIs, benchmarks, and reporting framework used across the organization
  • Own our approach to conversion measurement, including attribution methodology and tracking tools, so creator activity can be credibly tied to downstream results such as installs, trials, and paid subscriptions

What you'll bring

  • 5-7 years of experience in influencer, creator, or social media marketing, including experience managing celebrity or macro talent
  • Proven experience managing budgets and negotiating or overseeing creator contracts
  • Experience leading or mentoring team members
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience in attribution, performance reporting, and ROI analysis
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills
  • Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creator ecosystems 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in health, fitness, nutrition, or consumer subscription apps
  • Familiarity with mobile measurement partners, affiliate platforms, and creator management tools
  • Experience with AI tools and automations a plus

Exciting Full-Time Employee Benefits, Perks and Culture

Face-to-Face Connections: We value personal connections. Enjoy opportunities to meet and connect with your team members in person to help forge meaningful relationships that extend beyond the virtual realm. Teams meet as often as needed and all of MyFitnessPal gathers annually.

Flexibility At Its Best: Achieve the work-life balance you deserve. Enjoy a flexible time-off policy with our Responsible Time Off benefit. 

Give Back: Use  your volunteer days off to support what matters most to you. Each full time teammate receives 2 days per calendar year to give back to their community through service.

Mentorship Program: Take control of your career through our mentorship program where, if you’d like, you will be matched with a teammate who can help you scale your skills and propel your growth.

Family-Friendly Support: Embrace the journey with confidence and care. Enjoy our paid maternity and paternity leave, to provide time to balance family responsibilities with your career and take the time needed to strengthen family relationships.  We understand the complexities of starting or expanding a family, which is why we provide best-in-class comprehensive assistance for fertility-related matters. 

Wellness Comes First: Live Good Health is one of our core values. Receive a monthly Wellness Allowance, empowering you to focus on your physical and mental well-being by choosing from a range of wellness initiatives, including dedicated mental health days.

Celebrate Greatness: Your hard work deserves recognition! Our reward and recognition platform empowers peers to acknowledge and reward each other for the exceptional contributions they make. 

Elevate Your Health & Fitness: Get access to MyFitnessPal Premium, allowing you to take your fitness, health and wellness journey to new heights.

Unlock Your Potential: Access our virtual learning and development library, and participate in training opportunities  to continuously grow and enhance your skills. 

Championing Inclusion: Our dedicated DEI Committee actively fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace by setting actionable goals and evaluating progress across the organization.

Healthcare Matters: Your well-being is our priority. Take advantage of our competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits that cater to your holistic healthcare needs. Feel secure and supported on your wellness journey.

Secure Your Future: Benefit from our retirement savings program, giving you peace of mind for your financial goals. Reach them sooner with MyFitnessPal’s competitive employer match.

 

At MyFitnessPal, our mission is to enable people to make healthy choices. And it wouldn't be possible without our team. We celebrate the unique POV that each person brings to the table and believe in a collaborative and inclusive environment. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination on the basis of race, religion, military or veteran status, sex, gender, marital status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability. These are our guiding ideologies and apply across all aspects of employment.

job.description:
Keep Growing with Nutrafol

We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey.

Our multi-factorial approach targets key root causes of hair thinning using a patented blend of standardized vitamins, minerals and natural ingredients -- and is recommended by over 7,500 physicians and hair professionals for trusted, reliable results. We never settle, and are continuously challenging existing treatments and methodologies to advance the frontier of hair science. As we help our customers grow, we grow too -- by embracing individuality and differences, leading by example, and empowering ourselves and others with our passion for wellness and innovation.

Keep growing. It’s our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to realizing their own potential to grow.

About You:

The Product Development & Marketing Manager is a hands-on product innovation marketer who will help shape what we launch next. Sitting within the Product Development & Marketing team, this role turns consumer insights, clinical science and market trends into new products and line extensions across our dietary supplement and topical hair care portfolios, and guides them from early concept through stage-gate development to launch and beyond.

Reporting into the Sr. Manager of Product Development & Marketing, this role works across a dynamic portfolio of projects rather than a single fixed category, moving between dietary supplements and topical cosmetic innovation as business priorities evolve. You will partner closely with Brand Marketing, Consumer Insights, Education, Growth, Retention, Retail, Professional, Creative, Copy, Formulation, Packaging, Operations, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Legal, Quality and Clinical & Medical Affairs, serving as the day-to-day contact who keeps each project on strategy, on time and on budget across our multi-channel business, including direct to consumer, Amazon, healthcare professionals, salons and prestige retail.

Responsibilities:

Competitive Landscape & Innovation Strategy:

  • Own the competitive landscape from the product perspective, tracking competitor launches, formulations, ingredients, claims, clinical results, pricing and packaging across supplement and topical hair care.
  • Build and maintain a centralized competitive intelligence hub, including product benchmarks, claims and ingredient matrices and pricing architecture, that serves as the single source of truth for the team and cross-functional partners.
  • Support the Sr. Manager and Consumer Insights team to bring consumer research together with competitive and product intelligence, organizing the combined view into clear opportunity assessments and product recommendations.
  • Deliver regular competitive readouts that flag threats and whitespace, and use them to inform the innovation pipeline and roadmap.
  • Build compelling business cases for new concepts, including market sizing, consumer rationale, pricing, volume forecasts and margin targets, to secure stage-gate approval.

Product Development & Stage-Gate:

  • Execute the stage-gate process and all deliverables for assigned projects across supplements and topicals, from ideation and concept through development, commercialization and launch.
  • Write product, creative and copy briefs, defining the target consumer, benefits, claims ambition, format and cost targets, grounded in competitive benchmarks and product differentiation as approved by leadership.
  • Develop product claims in partnership with Formulation and Clinical & Medical Affairs, grounded in how ingredients and studies support efficacy. Own them through Regulatory and Legal review to final approval for packaging, marketing and launch materials.
  • Drive feasibility reviews with Packaging, Operations and Supply Chain for each concept. Confirm it can be manufactured, scaled and hit target cost of goods (COGS) and margin before each stage gate, and resolve any issues that would affect launch timing, raising risks to leadership as needed.

Positioning, Claims & Go-to-Market:

  • Develop product positioning, value propositions, naming direction and core messaging that set new launches apart from the competition, aligning with senior Product and Brand leadership. 
  • Shape claims strategy in partnership with Clinical & Medical Affairs and Regulatory, ensuring structure/function and cosmetic claims are compelling, substantiated and compliant with FDA, FTC and NAD guidelines.
  • Support development of new product assets that communicate efficacy and results (clinical before/afters, certification content, testing content, etc.).
  • Build integrated go-to-market plans with Brand Marketing, Growth, Retention, Retail and Professional teams, tailoring launch strategies by channel and audience.
  • Brief Creative, Copy and Packaging teams on launch assets that communicate efficacy, including clinical before-and-afters and testing content.
  • Partner with Education to create sell-in materials, product training and FAQs for retail partners, healthcare professionals, stylists and Customer Experience teams.
  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs to ensure clinical and scientific validation is reflected accurately in marketing communications.

Launch Performance & Lifecycle Management:

  • Track post-launch performance against defined KPIs and competitive response, sharing learnings and recommending adjustments to positioning, claims or assortment.
  • In partnership with the Sr. Manager, identify opportunities to strengthen the existing portfolio through reformulations, line extensions, new formats and updated claims.

Regulatory & Quality Partnership:

  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance on compliance and product certifications for both dietary supplements and topical/cosmetic products.
  • Proof packaging artwork and copy for accuracy, regulatory compliance and brand alignment.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in product development, innovation and/or product marketing within supplements, OTC, beauty or personal care; hair care or skincare preferred
  • Proven track record of taking products from concept to launch through a cross-functional stage-gate process, ideally across omnichannel businesses 
  • Demonstrated experience conducting competitive analysis and product benchmarking, with the ability to organize complex market and consumer information into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Strong business acumen, including building business cases, forecasts and pricing recommendations
  • Working knowledge of claims substantiation and regulatory considerations for structure/function and/or cosmetic claims (FDA, FTC & NAD), including taking claims through Regulatory and Legal review 
  • Experience writing product, creative and copy briefs that drive clear, on-strategy work
  • Ability to translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, compelling, consumer-friendly language
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented; thrives managing multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; SPINS, Circana or Amazon data experience a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
Nutrafol takes into consideration a wide range of factors in final compensation decisions, including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. The listed range is applicable only to the annual base salary and does not include additional perks, benefits, or applicable bonus eligibility comprising the total compensation package.
Salary Range:
$120,000—$130,000 USD

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Nutrafol is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, pregnancy (including breast feeding and related medical conditions), national origin, citizenship status, uniform service member status, age, genetic information, disability, and for employees working in California, ancestry, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, marital status, protected medical condition, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state and local laws.

Perks & Benefits

  • Fully remote work experience
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package, including FSA/HSA program
  • 401K with employer match
  • Quarterly Bonus Program
  • Flexible PTO
  • Two company-wide wellness breaks every day
  • Free lunch on us every Tuesday and Thursday via Seamless/Grubhub
  • Monthly wellness stipend
  • Monthly internet stipend
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Annual learning & development stipend
  • Free meditation app membership (Headspace)
  • Free monthly Nutrafol subscription
  • Pet insurance discounts and benefits

Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada Health is looking for an experienced product marketing leader to help us win in GLP-1 and cardiometabolic health. This role supports our new program development marketing, including GLP-1 solutions, with an emphasis on differentiated positioning, commercial execution, and bringing new offerings to market. This is a hands-on player-coach role with one direct report. Your primary focus will be leading strategy and personally delivering high-impact work, complemented by focused coaching and development of a product marketer.

job.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

This role owns how Pinterest shows up with key industry associations and on the industry's biggest stages, like Cannes Lions and Pinterest Presents. You'll be the connective tissue between Pinterest's leaders and the external industry across global tentpoles, shaping visibility, influence and reputation across the advertising and marketing landscape.

The ideal candidate brings strong integrated marketing expertise, excellent judgment, and the ability to lead through influence across a wide range of cross-functional partners. You are equally comfortable setting direction, shaping narratives, and driving excellent execution against high-priority business objectives.

What you’ll do:

  • Own Pinterest’s industry presence, including executive speaking opportunities, external storytelling, and thought leadership at priority global tentpoles.
  • Develop programming for Pinterest-owned events and global industry tentpoles, including talking points, fireside chats, client panels, testimonial videos, and more.
  • Inform Pinterest's speakership strategy and lead execution across key global tentpoles— including Cannes Lions and Pinterest Presents — sourcing, pitching and securing speaking opportunities that match the right Pinterest voices to the right stages and ladder up to business priorities.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration across regional and global stakeholders to align on priority opportunities, streamline execution, and deliver high-impact industry programs.
  • Prepare and support internal spokespeople and executives for speaking engagements, developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with Comms to establish a consistent, compelling Pinterest story across every stage moment.
  • Build and activate integrated partnership opportunities with clients and third-party partners that strengthen Pinterest’s industry relevance and contribute to business growth.
  • Lead end-to-end planning across briefs, workbacks, budgets, approvals, dependencies, logistics, and launch readiness to ensure programs are delivered with excellence.
  • Support measurement and optimization by defining success metrics, tracking program impact, and translating results into actionable recaps and recommendations 
  • Stay ahead of industry and competitive trends to identify opportunities for Pinterest to lead timely, relevant conversations with senior brand and agency decision-makers.
  • Use AI to accelerate research, speaker briefing prep, event planning and reporting, while applying judgment and verification to establish correctness and quality.

What we’re looking for:

  • A minimum of 8 years of experience in integrated marketing, B2B marketing, product marketing, brand marketing, and/or digital marketing, ideally within technology, media, advertising, agency, or platform environments.
  • Experience developing and leading multi-channel marketing programs from strategy through execution, measurement, and optimization.

job.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the systems behind our marketing programs and connect them to the BDR and sales teams so they run as one motion rather than a series of handoffs. When Marketing launches a program, this person makes sure it's built, QA'd, and lands cleanly with reps. When a BDR identifies an opportunity, this person makes sure the data, lists, and programs behind it are ready to act on immediately. The quality and completeness of our GTM data is what makes that speed possible, and as we expand into new segments and apply more AI and automation across the revenue engine, that foundation matters more every quarter.

You'll join a Revenue Operations team that has built the core routing, enrichment, and funnel infrastructure, and you'll have room to improve each of them. Because marketing systems feed directly into the sales process, you'll also partner with Sales and BDR teams on Salesforce work that keeps pipeline moving, and help harden routing, enrichment, and data hygiene alongside the rest of RevOps.

This role is built for someone who ramps fast and runs independently. With documented systems and SOPs to lean on, you'll be expected to own your queue within your first 30–45 days and make sound calls without waiting for sign-off. Day-to-day operational support is a real part of the job, but the greater impact comes from identifying and building durable, scalable solutions that drive revenue. The ideal candidate builds strong relationships across Sales, Marketing, and BDR leadership, treats data as a strategic asset, and consistently prioritizes the work with the greatest business impact.

This is a contractor role with opportunity to convert to full time hire.

How You'll Make an Impact:

- 

Own Market program operations end to end, including builds, templates, segmentation, scoring, and QA. This covers campaigns, events, direct mail, and BDR-driven outreach, so programs launch cleanly and hand off to reps without friction.

- 

Operate and evolve inbound lead routing, assignment logic, and enrichment with the broader RevOps team. Keep rules accurate as territories and segments change, and make sure records arrive complete enough for a rep to act on.

- 

Build and scale foundational ops architecture across our stack, including lead lifecycle and account funnel models, lead status, and deduplication and RingLead matching rules.

- 

Serve as the operational partner to Sales and BDR teams on Salesforce requests, record hygiene, and reporting, turning recurring asks into repeatable workflows.

- 

Identify and ship improvements across our marketing stack that increase pipeline, improve speed to lead, or make Sales and Marketing more efficient.

- 

Prioritize incoming requests from Marketing, Sales, and BDR leadership, and communicate tradeoffs directly when capacity is constrained.

What Makes You a Good Fit:

- 

5+ years in Marketing Operations or Revenue Operations, including hands-on Salesforce work supporting Sales and BDR teams and systems ownership rather than campaign execution alone.

- 

Deep hands-on Marketo experience, including program architecture, smart lists, scoring, and the Salesforce sync.

- 

A track record of driving measurable outcomes through systems and data work, such as faster lead response, higher inbound conversion, or better pipeline visibility.

- 

A builder's orientation toward scalable solutions, with examples of turning recurring operational issues into durable processes or automation while still managing day-to-day demands.

- 

You drive work forward rather than waiting for it. Given an outcome, you define the problem, propose the approach, flag risks early, and ship.

- 

Strong Salesforce administration skills, including objects and relationships, field architecture, validation rules, flows, and reporting.

- 

Practical Clay experience, including waterfall enrichment and Salesforce writeback, and comfort working with data outside the UI through SQL, scripting, or spreadsheets at scale.

- 

A data steward's mindset. You notice when a field is misused, fix root causes rather than symptoms, document systems as you build them, and treat record quality as a shared asset.

- 

Proven ability to build strong relationships across stakeholder groups with competing priorities, and the judgment to focus effort where it matters most.

Preferred Qualifications:

- 

Familiarity with Palantir Foundry, or a warehouse-centric reporting stack that feeds GTM systems.

- 

Outreach, LeanData, RingLead, or Gong administration experience.

- 

Experience applying AI and workflow automation to GTM operations, whether through Clay, Zapier, n8n, or LLM-based enrichment and classification.

- 

Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

Compensation:  This is a temporary independent contractor (1099) position with an initial contract duration of six (6) months, with the potential to extend or evolve based on business needs and mutual fit. The hourly rate range for this contract is $75 – $130* per hour and will vary based on factors including skill level, relevant experience, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and geographic location. This position is not eligible for company-sponsored benefits. As an independent contractor, the individual is solely responsible for maintaining any required liability insurance, other applicable insurance coverage, benefits, and for the payment of all applicable federal, state, and local taxes. We consider qualified applicants consistent with applicable law. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with legal requirements. This contract position is subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the terms of the contractor agreement.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

job.title: Senior Google Ads Buyer, DTC eCommerce (Remote)
job.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

- Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

- Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

- Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

- Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

- Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

- Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.

- Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.

- Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.

- Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

- Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

- You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.

- You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.

- You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.

- You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.

- You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.

- You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

- Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

- "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.

- You want to be told what to do this week.

- You need a ticketing system to know what matters.

- You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

job.description:
We are looking for a Senior UA Manager (Google Ads) to own and scale our Google Ads big monthly budget, drive 2-3x growth in scale while keeping CPA and ROAS within target, and shape the testing roadmap across creatives, audiences, and bidding strategies together with our Creative and Product Marketing teams. This is a role for someone who thrives on data, owns outcomes end-to-end, and wants their decisions to directly move the needle for a product reaching hundreds of thousands of users worldwide
 
About our product: We are building one of the most powerful live-streaming platforms, already connecting 400K+ monthly active users through live events, interactive video chats, and real-time community experiences. Our mission is bold: bring joy, fight loneliness, and deliver safe, ad-free entertainment that keeps people coming back. This is a complex, fast-moving space, and we love it that way! So, you will join a passionate, expert team tackling everything from scaling AI-powered recommendations to launching high-impact, data-driven features that boost monetization and engagement. Every idea counts here, and every release reaches a massive global audience. We are among the Top 5 streaming products in the US and rank in the Top 10 worldwide. Our next milestone: break into the global Top 5, and we are moving fast to make it happen. Are you in?

- Own and manage traffic acquisition in Google Ads (App campaigns/UAC and Web/PMax/Search), from hypothesis testing to scaling

- Scale the Google Ads direction 2-3x from the current budget while staying within defined KPIs (CPA/ROAS/ROMI)

- Build and execute a testing roadmap covering creatives, audiences, keywords/signals, and budget strategies, selecting optimal placements for each campaign type

- Build and optimize test structures and scaling rules and criteria for campaigns, monitoring CPA and ROI on a daily basis

- Work closely with Creative and PMM teams to generate and validate new hypotheses specific to Google Ads (app and web)

- Analyze and optimize campaigns based on data (AppsFlyer, Tableau, Google Analytics/Firebase), identifying growth opportunities and risks across different traffic sources (app/web)

- 3+ years of experience in performance marketing for mobile apps (video streaming/live/social apps is a plus)

- Hands-on experience buying traffic in Google Ads (Web/Web2app/App campaigns), from launch to scaling

- Experience managing budgets above $300K per month within the Google channel

- Deep understanding of Google Ads algorithm mechanics (Smart Bidding, tCPA/tROAS, signals)

- Solid knowledge of unit economics, cohort analysis, and key performance metrics (CPA, ROAS, LTV, Retention)

- Experience working with MMPs and attribution (AppsFlyer/Adjust), understanding attribution logic

- Experience with BI tools (Tableau, AppsFlyer, Google Analytics/Firebase) for data-driven analysis and decision-making

- Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher English proficiency

- Experience with other search networks

- Experience automating campaign launches, testing, and reporting with AI tools (Google Ads API, Google Ads Scripts)

Care and support:

- 20 paid vacation days, 15 sick leave days, and 6 additional days off for family events

- 100% medical insurance coverage

- Sports and equipment reimbursement

- Team building events, corporate gifts, and stylish merch

- Financial and legal support

- Maternity Recovery Support Allowance

- Position retention and support for those who join the Armed Forces of Ukraine

- Participation in social initiatives supporting Ukraine 

 

 

Comfortable working environment: 

- Work from our Kyiv hub or remotely with a flexible schedule

- Modern equipment or depreciation of your own tools 

 

 

Investment in your future: 

- Collaborate with a highly-skilled team of Middle & Senior professionals, sharing practical cases and expertise in the social networking niche

- 70% of our heads and leads have grown into their roles here – so can you!

- Performance-oriented reviews and Individual Development Plans (IDPs)

- Reimbursement for professional courses and English classes

- Corporate library, book club, and knowledge-sharing events

- Intro call

- Technical interview

- Interview with Direct Manager/Head

- Bar-raising

- Reference check

- Offer
